camera_target: none. There is no in-phone camera in this film. `.screen-world` holds scale 1 / x 0 / y 0 for the whole scene, the .device wrapper and its `scale(0.9428)` rig sizing are static CSS and are never tweened, and no data-camera-target attribute remains in the scene.

entry.vector: 0 px/s of camera travel — nothing zooms, pans or scales. The scene opens mid-BUILD instead of mid-move: the device is on-frame and unchanged from frame 16, and at t=0 the app chrome is already arriving (header 0.04-0.50s, bottom nav 0.08-0.58s) with the stage title cascade igniting at 0.12s. The cut from frame 16 lands on continuing content, not on a continuing move.

exit.vector: 0 px/s. The last authored reveal — the stage glow answering the finished ranking — completes at 11.70s, and nothing enters, exits or moves for the final 0.30s. Frame 18 opens on the same still, un-zoomed screen geometry, so the seam is a content cut, not a velocity match.

notes.first_second: Device + screen on-frame at t=0, carried unchanged from frame 16 and never transformed. The המלצות page head whips in (h1 0.42s, subtitle 0.58s) over an empty app-main; the tab rail has not landed yet and the slide card has not arrived. Stage title fragments whip at 0.12s / 0.32s, the rule fills at 0.50s, first body line at 0.86s.
notes.last_second: Static. The three trailing tracks finish filling at 10.68s and the stage glow bloom resolves at 11.70s; 11.70-12.00s is deliberate stillness before the cut.
notes.signature: The 29% match ring DRAWS — a measured getTotalLength stroke-dashoffset on the ring hugging the leading row's rank circle, 3.60s -> 5.60s on power2.out — while the mint % badge counts 0 -> 29 on the same start, ease and duration. At 12s the APPROACH was shortened (row 2.70s, rank 2.92s, name 3.18s) but the draw still owns two full seconds. The `10/35 חנויות תואמות` badge spring-pops at 5.54s, landing exactly as the draw completes. The leader's progress track then fills FROM THE RIGHT (scaleX 0 -> 1, transform-origin right center) 5.95-6.85s, the app's own right-anchored fill.
notes.staged_reveals: Where the camera used to own time, content does: chrome + page head 0.04-0.86s, tab rail 1.02-1.54s, slide card and its head 1.62-2.84s, the leading club scored 2.70-6.85s, the runner-up row 6.95-9.08s, ranks 3-5 as one shrinking-gap cascade with their fills 9.10-10.68s, then the stage glow reacts 10.70-11.70s. No idle loop, no breathe, no float — every tween is a one-shot arrival or a reaction to a completed beat.
notes.content: Five ranked rows, longer than the viewport: rows 1-4 read fully, row 5 is clipped at the fold exactly as the real screen scrolls. Every club is from the real ten — Mastercard Israel 29% (10/35), Isracard TopCash 10% (31/300), Behatsdaa 7% (58/831), HOT Israel 5% (284/5671), Hever (חבר) — טעמים 4% (18/461). The fills are genuinely short (29% and 10%, not 72%), so the track reads as a measurement rather than a decoration.
